display_long_description:
The first VR game built entirely around your voice. No menus, no controllers, just real-time conversations and interactions.

Welcome to Stellar Cafe, a coffee shop at the edge of the galaxy filled with quirky robots with bizarre ambitions and a lot to say. Pull up a seat, order whatever you can imagine, and meet a rotating cast of unforgettable characters. You might end up helping a robot quit their job, be a guest on their podcast, or chase their dreams. Your voice steers the story.
[media]

# Voice-First Gameplay

Speak to the robots and they speak back. No dialog trees, just direct understanding and interaction all in real-time. Be creative and expressive, conversations are fully dynamic and driven by your voice!

[media]

# Hand Tracking

Use your hands, you want to grab it, do it! Reach, grab, sip, point and toss objects in your environment just like real-life. From adding creamer to your coffee to flinging a bottle of hot sauce at a robot, let both your hands and your voice do the talking.
[media]

# Colorful Cast of Characters

Every robot has a unique personality, goals, and quirks.  Make a friend (or not) and uncover their stories.

Humor
Experience a new brand of humor where your voice helps drive the comedy.*

Supports English Language

*Performance and outcomes are subject to variability based on the individual. We are not liable for the lack of humor generated by the human. Side effects may include eye rolls, snorts, or the occasional "that was clever"
